verdict.rationale: Zulip documents a bot framework for interactive bots that react to messages. These bots can be deployed on the Zulip Botserver so they stay up in production, and incoming webhooks plus Zapier/IFTTT integrations allow event-driven automation. However, background automation means writing and hosting custom bot code or relying on third-party automation tools, not a native automation builder. Missing for 10: built-in no-code automation/workflow setup, scheduled or triggered autonomous jobs beyond message reactions, AI/agent-driven automation, independent hands-on corroboration.
